'''John William Dold''' (also known as '''Bill Dold''') is an emeritus professor in the [[Department of Mathematics, University of Manchester|department of mathematics]] in the [[University of Manchester]], a specialist in the field of [[Fluid Mechanics]] and [[Combustion]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.maths.manchester.ac.uk/about/people/academic-and-research-staff/ |title=Academic and research staff (A-Z), Department of Manthematics, University of Manchester |website=maths.manchester.ac.uk |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://personalpages.manchester.ac.uk/staff/john.dold/web/index.html |title=Prof. John Dold, University of Manchester |website=personalpages.manchester.ac.uk |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref><ref name="googlescholar">{{cite web |publisher=[[Google Scholar]] |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=aHV4qrkAAAAJ&hl |title=John Dold |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref> He was the founder of the journal [[Combustion Theory and Modelling]].

==Biography and research==
John attended school at the [[Christian Brothers College, Bulawayo]] in [[Zimbabwe]]. He completed his bachelors (1971–1974) at the [[University of Zimbabwe]] and his doctoral degree (1976–1979) at the [[Cranfield University]] under the supervision of [[John Frederick Clarke]].<ref name="ethos">{{cite thesis |url=https://ethos.bl.uk/OrderDetails.do?uin=uk.bl.ethos.453791 |title=British Library EThOS: On the auto-ignition and combustion of a finite region of gaseous fuel |year=1979 |type=Ph.D |last1=Dold |first1=J. W. |website=ethos.bl.uk |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref> He obtained a master's degree (1971–1974) in area studies at the [[University of London]].<ref name="linkedin">{{cite web |publisher=[[LinkedIn]] |url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/john-dold-5411a322 |title=John Dold |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref>

He then joined the faculty of the mathematics department at the [[University of Bristol]] and then joined the faculty of mathematics department at the [[University of Manchester]] in 1995. In 1997, he along with Mitchell D. Smooke, founded the journal [[Combustion Theory and Modelling]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/259399450 |title=Combustion Theory and Modelling:Devoted to the publication and dissemination of scientific articles that apply mathematical theory, modelling, numerical simulation and experimental techniques to the study of combustion. |website=researchgate.net |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref> He also worked at [[Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Service]] from 2010 to 2013. He served as the vice president of [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|SIAM]] United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland Section from 1998 to 1999.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.siam.org/membership/sections/detail/united-kingdom-and-republic-of-ireland-of-siam-ukie-siam |title=SIAM United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland Section. Section Archive |website=siam.org |access-date=6 March 2024}}</ref> He also served as the editor for [[Combustion Theory and Modelling]] and [[SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics]].

John Dold has made significant contributions in theoretical combustion science, particularly in areas related to partially premixed combustion, [[fire]], ignition, [[detonation]]s and also in the field of fluid mechanics and water waves. [[Kerr–Dold vortex]], an exact solution of [[Navier–Stokes equations]] is named after him,
